description: QR code. Send text or a URL (up to 1,000 characters); returns a QR code as PNG or SVG, base64 in JSON, with its size, version and error-correction level, at the scale and quiet zone you choose. Use to put a link or payment request on a page, label or PDF. Plain codes only, no logos or colours. Typical response under 200 ms. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

border.description: Quiet zone in modules, 0 to 10 (4 is the standard).

error_correction.description: L, M, Q or H; the highest level that fits without a bigger code is used.
